name: @wierdbytes/pi-memory
description: pi extension for wierd-memory: injects the approved memory index into sessions, adds memory_search / memory_read / memory_inbox tools and runs dreams for the wierd-memory server.
//: The development manifest (pi install <repo>/packages/pi loads ./index.ts from source). npm gets the bundle `bun run build:pi` writes to dist/ with its own manifest (scripts/build-pi.ts); private keeps this one from being published.
author: wierdbytes
